name: Leaky JWT
description: A token endpoint signs JWTs with the 'none' algorithm accepted by the verifier. Forge an admin token for user 'root'.

name: SQL Login Bypass
description: A login form builds 'SELECT * FROM users WHERE u='$user' AND p='$pass'. Supply credentials that bypass authentication.

name: Base64 Secrets
description: An intercepted blob decodes through 3 layers of base64 then ROT13. Recover the plaintext flag.

name: XOR Repeating Key
description: Ciphertext from XOR with a 3-byte repeating key. Recover the key and decrypt to obtain the flag.

name: Format String
description: A vulnerable printf(user_input) leaks a stack canary then a saved return address. Use it to read a secret at a known offset.

name: Buffer Overflow ROP
description: A 64-bit binary with a stack buffer overflow and no win() imported. Build a ROP chain to call mprotect + shellcode.

name: Weak PRNG
description: A 'secure' token is generated with a 32-bit seed from time(). Brute force the seed space to predict the next token.

name: Hidden EXIF
description: A published photo hides the flag in EXIF Comment and a trailing steghide payload. Extract both.

name: PCAP Credentials
description: A pcap contains a plaintext FTP session. Reassemble the stream to recover the uploaded flag file.

name: Reverse Me
description: A stripped ELF prints 'wrong' unless argv[1] equals the result of a simple linear transformation. Recover the expected input.

name: API Key in Repo
description: A public git repo's .env is committed. Pull it and use the leaked key to authenticate to /admin.

name: SSTI
description: A templated greeting endpoint renders user input. Achieve RCE via server-side template injection to read /flag.

name: RSA Small e
description: RSA with e=3 and short message m^3 < n. Recover m via integer cube root (no factoring needed).

name: Command Injection
description: A ping tool concatenates user input into a shell command. Inject a second command to cat /flag.

name: Heap UAF
description: A use-after-free lets you retake a freed chunk and overwrite a function pointer. Hijack it to call system('/bin/sh').

name: Binary Entropy
description: A disk image hides the flag in the unused (slack) space of a FAT partition. Carve it out.

name: Timing Attack
description: A secret-comparison routine returns early on first mismatch. Recover a 16-byte secret byte-by-byte via response-time oracle.

name: Obfuscated JS
description: A license-check script packs the validation in eval(atob(...)). Deobfuscate to learn the valid key format and forge one.

name: NoSQL Injection
description: A MongoDB login accepts a JSON body. Use a query operator to authenticate as any user without a password.

name: Hardcoded Secret
description: An Android APK embeds the API flag in a string resource. Extract it with apktool/strings.
